blind.description: A segment of architectural roof ridge capping or flashing, featuring a rounded semi-cylindrical top ridge flanked by sloping side flanges with rounded welt seams/straps spaced evenly along its length. The main exterior has a dull, weathered dark grey metallic lead texture. The end cross-section reveals an interior cap face with a brownish/tan unfinished material tone and small seam markings. The surfaces are continuous and solid with clean geometric bevels, sitting completely flat directly on the ground plane without any separate base plinth.
blind.from_above: A vertically oriented rectangular bar composed of a rounded central spine flanked by two thin lateral flanges, divided into four segments by three raised cross-ribs or straps.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/8 to 1/10 the height of the figure (approx. 7-9 inches high), roughly 1.5 feet wide across the base, and about 3.5 to 4 feet long.
